# Tool library helper

A small helper that answers questions about the fictional Zephyr Lane Tool Library handbook
(`handbook.md`). It picks the handbook paragraph with the most words in common with the question.

## Setup

1. Install Python 3.12.
2. Nothing else is needed.

## Usage

```
python helper.py "How long can I borrow a drill?"
```

It prints the closest paragraph, or says it does not know.
